item.title: The Ultimate Irving Restaurant Guide: Where to Eat in One of DFW’s Most Diverse Dining Destinations
item.description: It should come as no surprise that Irving has so many top-shelf restaurants. Situated northwest of Downtown Dallas, the city draws both Dallas and Fort Worth diners, as well as travelers landing just 10 miles away at DFW.
